title: Expected Query Cost on Three Signs
statement: For every input $x\in\{−1,1\}^3$, the randomized decision tree's expected number of queries is $\frac{1}{3}\bigl((2\text{ if }x_0=x_1\text{, and }3\text{ otherwise})+(2\text{ if }x_0=x_2\text{, and }3\text{ otherwise})+(2\text{ if }x_1=x_2\text{, and }3\text{ otherwise})\bigr)$.
